{added} kayıt eklendi, {removed} silindi: {added} records added, {removed} deleted; some records could not be written:
Aşağıdaki DS kaydı alan adını aldığınız: Until the DS record below is entered at your domain registrar, resolution is not validated and DNSSEC provides no protection.
Atlanan satırların bir kısmı gösteriliyo: Only some of the skipped lines are shown.
Aynı ad ve türdeki var olan kayıtları de: Replace existing records with the same name and type
BIND biçimindeki bölge dosyasından {doma: Adds records to the {domain} zone from a BIND-format zone file.
Bölge dosyasını yapıştırın ya da bir dos: Paste the zone file or choose a file.
Bölge imzalanır ve ECDSA P-256 anahtarı: The zone is signed and an ECDSA P-256 key is generated. DNSSEC is not validated until the DS record is entered at your registrar; once it is, you must remove the DS before disabling DNSSEC.
Bölge imzalı yayınlanıyor. Yeni ve değiş: The zone is served signed. New and changed records are signed automatically.
No DS record could be generated for this key.
Çoğu firma yalnızca DS kaydını ister; ba: Most registrars only ask for the DS record; some also ask for the DNSKEY. Both are below.
DNSSEC açıldı. DS kaydını kayıt firmasın: DNSSEC enabled. Remember to enter the DS record at your registrar.
DNSSEC, yanıtların sahte olmadığını doğr: DNSSEC makes it possible to verify that answers are genuine. When enabled, the zone is signed with ECDSA P-256; you then need to enter the DS record at your domain registrar.
DNSSEC'i kapatmadan ÖNCE kayıt firmasınd: BEFORE disabling DNSSEC, remove the DS record at your registrar; otherwise the domain will not resolve.

There is nothing to add or delete.
En çok 512 KB ve 5000 kayıt. A, AAAA, CN: Up to 512 KB and 5000 records. A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SRV and CAA are imported; SOA and other types are skipped.
İlk {n} kayıt gösteriliyor; hepsi ekleni: Showing the first {n} records; all of them will be added.
Kapalıyken var olan kayıtlara dokunulmaz: When off, existing records are left alone and only missing ones are added.
Kapatmadan ÖNCE alan adını aldığınız kay: You must have removed the DS record at your registrar BEFORE disabling. If DNSSEC is disabled while the DS record is still in place, validating resolvers cannot resolve the domain; your site and mail become unreachable. After removing the DS, wait for its TTL to expire (usually 1–2 days).
The text can be at most {kb} KB.
